entries.title: Little Monsters

violence.summary: Scary monster faces, gross behavior, child scuffles, bullying, threatening behavior, and perilous scenes may scare sensitive viewers, though the tone is comic.

language.summary: CSM flags heavy-for-the-age profanity from both adults and kids, including several mild-to-moderate curses and potty words.

romance.summary: Women are objectified on TV and in Maurice's comments, and he briefly talks about touching himself.

drinking.summary: Parents drink wine at dinner, and a monster bully smokes cigarettes, blows smoke at others, and threatens burns with a cigarette butt.

handoffNotes: Catalog srcUrl is not CSM; targeted lookup found the matching 1989 CSM review.
Current CSM age is 8+, higher than the catalog ca of 7+.

romance.summary: Richie and Cadbury ogle Claudia Schiffer during a workout, and a few adult innuendos include comments about money and bodies.

violence.summary: A jilted bride slaps the groom and threatens to hit two children.

entries.title: Casper

violence.summary: Ghostly violence includes three deaths followed by ghost forms, willing attempts to enter the spirit world, a cliff death, cruel ghost pranks, Casper discussing his childhood death, vomiting on a priest, head-twisting, attempted vehicular harm, and bullying.

language.summary: Occasional profanity includes mild-to-moderate curses, religious exclamations, and a tween telling someone to go away rudely.

romance.summary: Adult and tween couples kiss, Casper has a crush and kisses Kat's cheek, and jokes include cleavage imagery, dropped trousers, and innuendo.

drinking.summary: Adults and adult ghosts drink, act drunk, and smoke cigars, and the lead villain smokes cigarettes.

handoffNotes: Death, spirit-world themes, and Casper's childhood death disclosure may need prose context.
